title: German Apple Crumble
description: A classic German dessert featuring tender apples topped with a crunchy oat and butter crumble. Perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: apples
ingredients.notes: a mix of Granny Smith and Gala

instructions: Peel, core, and slice the apples. Place them in a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, oats, brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Add the cold butter to the dry ingredients and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into a crumbly mixture.
If using the pre-made german crumble topping, sprinkle it evenly over the apples.
If not using the pre-made topping, add the crumb mixture to the apples and gently toss to combine.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
